description: This file defines the interface for network operations in the Wesnoth game, including connection management, data transmission, and statistics.

classes.name: network::manager
classes.description: Manages the lifecycle of network threads.

classes.name: network::server_manager
classes.description: Handles server-side listening on a specified port.

classes.name: network::connection_stats
classes.description: Stores statistics about a network connection.

methods.name: network::manager::manager
methods.description: Constructor for network manager, initializes with thread count.

methods.name: network::manager::~manager
methods.description: Destructor for network manager.

methods.name: network::server_manager::server_manager
methods.description: Constructs a server manager, optionally creating a server.

methods.name: network::server_manager::~server_manager
methods.description: Destroys the server manager.

methods.name: network::connect
methods.description: Attempts to connect to a remote host, returns connection handle.

methods.name: network::accept_connection
methods.description: Accepts an incoming connection.

methods.name: network::disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects a specific or all connections.

methods.name: network::queue_disconnect
methods.description: Queues a disconnection for later processing.

methods.name: network::receive_data
methods.description: Receives data from a connection or all connections.

methods.name: network::set_default_send_size
methods.description: Sets default maximum send size.

methods.name: network::send_data
methods.description: Sends data over a connection or broadcasts.

methods.name: network::queue_data
methods.description: Queues data to be sent later.

methods.name: network::process_send_queue
methods.description: Processes queued data for sending.

methods.name: network::send_data_all_except
methods.description: Sends data to all connections except one.

methods.name: network::ip_address
methods.description: Retrieves the IP address of a connection.

methods.name: network::get_connection_stats
methods.description: Gets statistics for a connection.

methods.name: network::error::error
methods.description: Constructs an error object with message and socket.

methods.name: network::error::disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects the socket associated with the error.

methods.name: network::statistics::fresh_current
methods.description: Resets current transfer stats.

methods.name: network::statistics::transfer
methods.description: Updates transfer statistics.

methods.name: network::get_send_stats
methods.description: Returns send statistics for a connection.

methods.name: network::get_receive_stats
methods.description: Returns receive statistics for a connection.
